```artifact
Feature: Alarms Management

  Scenario: Event Log Includes All Alarm Occurrences
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When an alarm occurs
    Then the event log includes the alarm occurrence

  Scenario: Event Log Includes All Alarm Inhibitions, Cancellations, Resets, Acknowledgements
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When an alarm is inhibited
    And an alarm is cancelled
    And an alarm is reset
    And an alarm is acknowledged
    Then the event log includes the alarm inhibition
    And the event log includes the alarm cancellation
    And the event log includes the alarm reset
    And the event log includes the alarm acknowledgement

  Scenario: GUI Allows Inhibiting Alarms
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the user inhibits an alarm
    Then the alarm is inhibited

  Scenario: GUI Allows Acknowledging Alarms
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the user acknowledges an alarm
    Then the alarm is acknowledged

  Scenario: GUI Allows Cancelling Alarms
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the user cancels an alarm
    Then the alarm is cancelled

  Scenario: GUI Allows Setting an Alarm on Inspiration Tidal Volume Above Threshold
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the user sets an alarm on inspiration tidal volume above 80 ml
    Then the alarm is set
    When the user sets an alarm on inspiration tidal volume above 3000 ml
    Then the alarm is set
    When the user sets an alarm on inspiration tidal volume above 90 ml
    Then the alarm is set

  Scenario: GUI Allows Setting an Alarm on PIP Above Threshold
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the user sets an alarm on PIP above 100
    Then the alarm is set
    When the user sets an alarm on PIP above 150
    Then the alarm is set
    When the user sets an alarm on PIP above 99
    Then the alarm is set

  Scenario: GUI Allows Setting an Alarm on Leakage Above Threshold
    Given the system is in a normal state
    When the user sets an alarm on leakage above 5 lpm
    Then the alarm is set
    When the user sets an alarm on leakage above 150 lpm
    Then the alarm is set
    When the user sets an alarm on leakage above 4 lpm
    Then the alarm is set

  Scenario Outline: Alarm Fires on Consecutive Breaths PIP Above Threshold
    Given the system is in a normal state
    And the user sets an alarm on PIP above <threshold>
    When the user takes <breaths> consecutive breaths with PIP above <threshold>
    Then the alarm fires

    Examples:
      | threshold | breaths |
      | 100       | 3       |
      | 150       | 3       |
      | 99        | 3       |

  Scenario Outline: Alarm Fires on Leakage Above Threshold
    Given the system is in a normal state
    And the user sets an alarm on leakage above <threshold>
    When the user takes <breaths> consecutive breaths with leakage above <threshold>
    Then the alarm fires

    Examples:
      | threshold | breaths |
      | 5         | 3       |
      | 150       | 3       |
      | 4         | 3       |
```
